data.cultural_impact: The name Vibhor holds immense significance in Hindu culture, as it is believed to be a divine name of Lord Shiva. The name Vibhor is a reminder of Lord Shiva's wisdom, power, and intelligence, and is often invoked for protection, prosperity, and spiritual growth.

The name signifies intelligence, power, and wisdom, which are essential attributes for a spiritual seeker. It is believed that calling upon Lord Shiva by the name Vibhor can bring blessings of knowledge, understanding, and spiritual growth. The name also serves as a reminder of the ultimate reality, which is beyond the limitations of the physical world and can be accessed through the liberation of the soul.

historical_references.reference: Vibhor is mentioned as the name of a Yaksha in Hindu scriptures, particularly the Mahabharata and the Puranas. Yakshas were nature deities or guardians of treasures and were often depicted as having immense physical strength and supernatural abilities.
Vibhor is also referenced as a title or epithet for various Hindu gods, such as Shiva and Vishnu. For instance, in the Shiva Purana, Vibhor is one of the many names of Shiva.
